description: This file defines a custom module for Odoo (formerly OpenERP) that extends the 'product.product' model to include margin and financial analysis functions related to product sales and purchases, including calculations of margins, turnover, costs, and related metrics.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: A model extending 'product.product' with additional margin and financial metrics functions.

methods.name: _product_margin
methods.description: Computes various margin and financial metrics for products based on invoice data within specified date ranges and invoice states.
